subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed under the existing outbound-hook cluster while normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics are handled as a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The source-level Feishu `message_sending` gap is a bug, but allowing passive plugins to claim normal inbound channel traffic changes pre-routing authority, ordering, and security semantics across channels.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix the Feishu outbound dispatcher hook gap now and track normal `inbound_claim` broadening separately with an explicit plugin API contract.

options.title: Fold outbound work into canonical hook trackers
options.body: Treat the outbound half as owned by the existing message hook coverage issues and keep this issue only for Feishu evidence plus the inbound-claim decision.

options.title: Solve all requested hooks together
options.body: Land one broader PR for Feishu outbound hooks and normal `inbound_claim`, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix the Feishu outbound dispatcher hook gap now and track normal `inbound_claim` broadening separately with an explicit plugin API contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest decision-routing evidence is Vincent's merged inbound-claim authorization and plugin-claim hardening history.
